text:
raul (pm): Quick handoff for Q3 perf OKRs — posting the decision checklist + asks. Link: https://redwood.app/notes/q3-perf-handoff. Need owners for kernel work, quant pipeline, and KV rollout by EOD tomorrow.
sara (eng-runtime): Thanks. Just to confirm: target stack is hosted + dedicated parity for p50/p95 SLOs, right?
mike (eng-ml): Correct. Customer commitments (enterprise) require p50 <= 40ms for chat hosted baseline; dedicated can be higher but latency tail must be predictable. Also embedding throughput ask from Partner A — 2x throughput for v1.
jia (infra): For KV cache rollouts we need canary gates and a fallback path. Proposed canary metrics: `p50_latency_change <= 5%`, `p95_latency_change <= 10%`, `regen_rate <= 1.5%`, `error_rate_increase <= 0.1%`.
alex (eng-platform): Tradeoffs: aggressive prefix caching helps cost/latency but increases memory pressure and eviction churn. Need memory budgets per pool.
raul (pm): Draft initiative list (please react with priority 1/2/3): 1) Adaptive quant profiles for 7B/13B (cost reduction), 2) Kernel selection automation (per-model tuning), 3) KV prefix caching ops + canary, 4) Batching heuristics/backpressure improvements, 5) Canary & launch criteria standardization.
sara (eng-runtime): My quick priorities: 1) KV canary + fallback (prod reliability), 2) kernel selection infra (unblocks many experiments), 3) quant (needs eval harness).
mike (eng-ml): I'll take quant pipeline ownership. Can we scope an MVP: auto-quantize 7B with two profiles (speed/cost), baseline eval run on 10K prompts.
jia (infra): I'll own KV rollout plan and canary automation. Need a list of target datasets to measure regen quality. Suggest we reuse the 'customer-critical' prompt set.
alex (eng-platform): For kernel selection, we need a simple scoring function first. I can sketch it Monday. Dependency: we need perf traces with model metadata from the console.
raul (pm): Solid. Can we agree on launch criteria minimal checklist? Putting a first draft here — please edit inline: ```- Stability: no increase in customer-facing errors (>0.1%)
- Quality: regeneration rate <= 1.5% on golden set
- Performance: p95 <= baseline_p95 * 1.05 and p50 improvement or parity
- Cost: >= 20% unit cost reduction for quant path (7B)
- Ops: automated rollback & fallback tested in staging
- Observability: traces and token-level cost visible in console```
sara (eng-runtime): Minor tweak: make p95 gate owner-enforced per-model (some models have different tails). Also add "smoke test against flagship customer flow".
mike (eng-ml): Noted on eval harness. Will run initial runs and post numbers by Thu.
jia (infra): I'll add canary playbook + rollback steps to the doc.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary window created: canary/kv-cache - starts 2025-02-12T18:00Z.
raul (pm): OK — owners: mike -> quant, jia -> KV, alex -> kernel scoring, sara -> launch gating + perf validation. If anyone needs scope trimmed, call it out now. Otherwise I'll lock OKR list at EOD. :thumbsup:
sara (eng-runtime): Small ask: reserve a dedicated test pool for KV canary (so prod noise doesn't block).
jia (infra): Will request pool.
raul (pm): Thanks team — we'll sync tomorrow 11am to finalize owners and delivery windows.
